Title: Engraved Brass South Indian Coffee Filter, Traditional Decoction Maker Brewer
Description:
Bring the authentic taste and tradition of South Indian filter coffee into your home with this elegant solid brass coffee filter.
The filter features beautiful engraved decorative bands and a warm brushed-brass finish. Its traditional two-chamber design allows hot water to slowly pass through the coffee grounds, producing a rich and aromatic coffee decoction.
Perfect for preparing classic South Indian degree coffee, this brass filter is both functional and decorative. It also makes a thoughtful gift for coffee lovers, newly married couples, housewarming ceremonies and traditional Indian kitchens.

Product Features
Traditional South Indian coffee-filter design
Made from durable brass
Decorative engraved pattern
Upper chamber for ground coffee
Perforated press disc with handle
Lower chamber collects the coffee decoction
Matching brass lid with round knob
Reusable and environmentally friendly
Suitable for everyday use and gifting
Beautiful traditional kitchen décor
Package Includes
1 upper filtering chamber
1 lower decoction-collecting chamber
1 perforated pressing disc
1 matching brass lid
How to Use
Place freshly ground filter coffee in the upper chamber.
Position the perforated pressing disc over the coffee powder.
Slowly pour hot water into the upper chamber.
Cover it with the brass lid.
Allow the coffee decoction to drip into the lower chamber.
Mix the decoction with hot milk and sugar according to your preference.
